scientific_integrity: The finite polynomial identities and graph-type exhaustion have a self-contained proof and stand-alone exact checks. Historical priority outside inspected sources remains provisional. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The strict counterexample and sharp threshold diagram concern simple cubic graphs on six vertices; no general large-order classification or improved asymptotic bound is claimed. The result is compatible with weighted partition-function inequalities and the classical independent-set extremum.
title: The triangular prism defeats biclique extremality for almost-independent sets
